title: Legacy PowerShell DSC
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose of Legacy PowerShell DSC and define its core vocabulary.

content.intro: This lesson covers Legacy PowerShell DSC in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Configuration management compares intended state with observed state and applies a deliberate plan. Keep configuration data separate from implementation, validate desired values, detect drift, and clearly distinguish legacy Windows PowerShell DSC, the DSC 2.0 module, and standalone DSC 3.0.

content_blocks.title: Version and safety note
content_blocks.text: The main path targets modern PowerShell 7.6 LTS. Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatibility is labeled separately. Some providers, admin cmdlets and APIs depend on OS, module version, permissions or tenant access; the examples are static references, not proof of execution.
